backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as a placeholder backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implementation of seven requirements (hero section, services, market context, target clients, workflow, pilot program, contact) with high confidence and mapped test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing a Spanish-language BlueFire cybersecurity website with components for hero, services, market stats, clients, workflow, pilot program, contact form, and footer.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining cybersecurity-themed design tokens for light and dark modes including primary blues, accent cyans, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Spanish language attribute, SEO meta tags for BlueFire cybersecurity targeting Mexican PYMEs and maquiladoras, and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component orchestrating the single-page layout by rendering all section components (Hero, Services, MarketContext, TargetClients, Workflow, PilotProgram, Contact, Footer) in sequence.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section with Angel Medina's contact cards (email, phone, location) and a Spanish-labeled contact form with frontend-only validation displaying success messages without backend submission.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying BlueFire branding, services list, contact info, copyright with dynamic year, and caffeine.ai attribution link with UTM parameters using hostname as app identifier.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section with BlueFire Shield branding, Spanish tagline emphasizing Mexican cybersecurity protection, dual CTAs for evaluation and services, hero background image overlay, and three key statistics (40B+ attacks, 74% ransomware, 99.8% PYMEs).
frontend/src/components/MarketContextSec: Displays cybersecurity threat statistics for Mexico with four stat cards (cyberattacks, trends, affected companies, SME protection), a bar chart of most affected sectors (Finance, Health, Manufacturing), and an alert message about SME security gaps.
frontend/src/components/PilotProgramSect: Presents a pilot program offering a 48-hour vulnerability scanning service with deliverables, optional remediation/retainer services, a four-step process (contact, documents, execution, delivery), and a call-to-action button to scroll to the contact section.
Showcases four core cybersecurity services (Asset Registry, Vulnerability Assessment, Remediation, Network Segmentation) in a grid layout, each with description, necessity explanation for the Mexican market, and three key benefits.
frontend/src/components/TargetClientsSec: Defines target client segments comparing SMEs vs. Maquiladoras with their sales cycle characteristics, and displays four client types (Local SMEs, Manufacturing Plants, Supply Chain Providers, MSPs/IT Providers) with icons and descriptions.
Outlines the four-stage service workflow (Asset Registry, Vulnerability Assessment, Patching, Segmentation) with five detailed stages per service, plus an integrated workflow diagram image and explanatory note about the IT/OT methodology.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using Internet Identity, with React Query for caching and automatic query invalidation when the actor/identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with cybersecurity-themed color palette using OKLCH color space, defining CSS custom properties for light and dark modes with blue/cyan accent colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the theme with custom colors mapped to CSS variables, typography, container queries, animations, and cybersecurity-themed styling including glow effects.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining a Spanish-language cybersecurity presentation website for BlueFire targeting Mexican PYMEs, with detailed feature requirements, image specifications, and architectural notes for services including Asset Registry, Vulnerability Assessment, Remediation, and Network Segmentation.
